item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open(\"ledger.json\")); paid=sum(o[\"paid_won\"] for o in d[\"orders\"]); seen=set(); valid=[]; duplicate=[]
for x in d[\"refund_deliveries\"]:
 (duplicate if x[\"event_id\"] in seen else valid).append(x)
 seen.add(x[\"event_id\"])
print({\"paid_won\":paid,\"valid_refund_won\":sum(x[\"refund_won\"] for x in valid),\"expected_net_won\":paid-sum(x[\"refund_won\"] for x in valid),\"all_deliveries_refund_won\":sum(x[\"refund_won\"] for x in d[\"refund_deliveries\"]),\"all_deliveries_net_won\":paid-sum(x[\"refund_won\"] for x in d[\"refund_deliveries\"]),\"duplicate_delivery_ids\":[x[\"delivery_id\"] for x in duplicate],\"current_net_won\":d[\"current_net_won\"],\"current_test_expected_won\":d[\"current_test_expected_won\"],\"test_exit_code\":d[\"test_exit_code\"]})'"
